verdict.headline: Model demand-forecast-v3 is invalid due to an unhandled data type breaking change (INT to VARCHAR) in upstream feature source sales.raw_sales.holiday_flag.
verdict.reasoning: The model 'demand-forecast-v3' relies on feature table 'sales.feat_seasonality', which feeds into training job 'train_demand_forecast'. The schema for 'sales.feat_seasonality.holiday_flag' is expected as INT ('passed through from raw_sales; encoded at training time'). Upstream dataset 'sales.raw_sales.holiday_flag' was updated from INT to VARCHAR (now storing string holiday names or empty strings). This schema change breaks feature ingestion and encoding: string values cannot be passed directly as integer flags to the trained gradient-boosted model without explicit string-to-numeric encoding, and pipeline execution will fail on type casting or produce invalid predictions.

risks.title: Upstream Feature Encoding Mismatch on holiday_flag
risks.mechanism: Data type mismatch (INT -> VARCHAR) breaks assumptions in feature generation and model inference. Replacing numeric integer flags with holiday string names prevents proper feature encoding learned by the gradient-boosted model, leading to pipeline runtime errors or model invalidation.
evidence: sales.raw_sales.holiday_flag nativeDataType is VARCHAR with description 'Holiday name, or empty string when not a holiday.'
sales.feat_seasonality.holiday_flag nativeDataType is INT with description 'Passed through from raw_sales; encoded at training time.'
Lineage path connects sales.raw_sales -> sales.feat_seasonality -> train_demand_forecast -> demand-forecast-v3

recommended_actions: Halt automated inference/training jobs ('train_demand_forecast') for demand-forecast-v3 until schema compatibility is restored.
Update the feature engineering pipeline feeding 'sales.feat_seasonality' to parse/encode string values in 'sales.raw_sales.holiday_flag' into numeric binary/categorical features.
Retrain and evaluate 'demand-forecast-v3' on the updated feature encoding before redeploying to production.
